title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Visit Fee and Labor Rate Card
content:
This rate card sets the visit fees, the labor multiplier and the pricing terms of Repair and Emergency Service Calls in each call class. Repair tasks are priced from the Harbison flat-rate price book. Every class uses the 2026-03 edition.

## Fees and multipliers

| Call class | Diagnostic (dispatch) fee per visit | After-hours premium per visit | Labor multiplier on price-book labor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | $89.00 | $0.00 | 1.0 |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | $119.00 | $0.00 | 1.0 |
| Evening Service Call | $89.00 | $99.00 | 1.25 |
| Weekend Service Call | $89.00 | $119.00 | 1.25 |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | $89.00 | $189.00 | 1.5 |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | $89.00 | $249.00 | 1.5 |

## Pricing terms

| Call class | Price book edition | Second unit on the same visit charged no second diagnostic fee | Price quoted and approved before work is final | Written estimate valid for | Special-order parts deposit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call | 2026-03 | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | 50 percent of the parts amount |
| Same-Day Priority Service Call | 2026-03 | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | 50 percent of the parts amount |
| Evening Service Call | 2026-03 | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | 50 percent of the parts amount |
| Weekend Service Call | 2026-03 | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | 50 percent of the parts amount |
| Overnight Emergency Service Call | 2026-03 | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | 50 percent of the parts amount |
| Holiday Emergency Service Call | 2026-03 | Yes | Yes | 30 calendar days | 50 percent of the parts amount |

## Reading the card

- The diagnostic fee is charged once per visit.
- The after-hours premium is a flat amount for each visit in the class; it is $0.00 in the daytime weekday classes.
- The labor multiplier applies to the price-book labor amount of every repair task in the class.

## Worked figures (hypothetical repair)

- Price-book labor of $200.00 multiplied by the Weekend Service Call multiplier of 1.25 is $250.00 of labor.
- The same labor on an Overnight Emergency Service Call, multiplied by 1.5, is $300.00.
- A Standard Service Call or Same-Day Priority Service Call bills it at $200.00, because the multiplier is 1.0.
- A visit on a Holiday Emergency Service Call carries the $89.00 diagnostic fee and the $249.00 premium.
